maya: Quick runbook 1: need crisp hero + one-line sub + single CTA for Hosted API, Dedicated, Private pages. Keep heroes <12 words. Also 2 social hooks for announcement posts and a simple webinar->lead routing plan. Assigning: @leo Hosted, @toni Dedicated, @sam Private, @ellie routing. Deadline: Thu EOD.

leo: Hosted drafts (3 options, CTAs):
1) "Hosted API: production-ready inference, zero infra to manage." CTA: Get API key
2) "Fast hosted inference built for real product latency." CTA: Start hosted trial
3) "A hosted API that scales your LLM features predictably." CTA: Explore hosted API
Bench blurb: "Typical 99th-percentile latencies in the low-100s ms for common open models; lower unit cost vs naive self-hosting at scale (customer results vary)."

toni: Dedicated copy (short):
1) "Dedicated GPU pools for steady throughput and capacity control."
2) "Reserve GPUs, set autoscale policies, and hit steady SLOs."
3) "Predictable performance with enterprise controls and burst options." CTA: Request dedicated demo
Bench blurb: "Measured throughput improvements on sustained workloads with predictable cost per token; SLOs help avoid tail surprises."

sam: Private page (short):
1) "Private deployment: VPC and on-prem inference with strict controls."
2) "Customer-managed keys, audit logging, and air-gapped options."
3) "Full control over network and keys for regulated workloads." CTA: Schedule private eval
Bullets (one-line): "KMS/HSM support, isolated control plane, detailed audit trails."
Bench blurb: "Enterprise customers report easier compliance and comparable latency when colocated; costs depend on infra choices."

ellie: Simple webinar signup -> routing sketch (ops-friendly):
```
webinar_signup -> tag: webinar_2026_03
  0-12h: send thank-you + recording + quickstart link (marketing)
  if clicks 'Start trial' -> auto-provision trial + email series (product)
  if clicks 'Request demo' -> create lead in CRM -> assign to SDR queue by region
  if engaged (>=3 API calls in 48h) -> mark PQL -> AE alert + priority outreach
  follow-up cadence: 3 emails over 10 days, SDR call attempt at day 4 if demo requested
```
Hooks for social posts:
- Hook 1: "Ship LLM features without guessing latency or cost  join our webinar."
- Hook 2: "Hosted, Dedicated, Private: pick the serving model that matches your risk profile."

maya: Nice brevity. Quick notes: leo, favor option 1 or 3 for hosted; use 'Get API key' when possible. toni, swap 'SLA' wording to 'SLO' across Dedicated. sam, keep KMS/HSM + audit logs explicit. ellie, ops will want a CSV export of tagged leads.

leo: Updated hosted hero choice: "Hosted API: production-ready inference, zero infra to manage." CTA: Get API key. Final bench line (short): "Low-100s ms 99th latencies for typical open models; careful comparisons recommended."

toni: Final Dedicated pick: "Dedicated GPU pools for steady throughput and capacity control." CTA: Request dedicated demo. Final bench line: "Predictable throughput at sustained scale with clearer unit economics vs ad-hoc infra."

sam: Final Private pick: "Private deployment: VPC and on-prem inference with strict controls." CTA: Schedule private eval. Final bench line: "Comparable response times when deployed in customer networks; compliance benefits often justify the investment."

deploy-bot: Reminder set: Thu EOD deadline for copy deliverables.

maya: Thanks team 1 I'll stitch these into the landing copy doc, create the short launch post drafts, and send to legal for conservative language checks. I'll also drop ellie's routing sketch into the ops ticket. :rocket:
